title: Follow the Heron
meta_description: 2 Community Pools, Walk to Beach- Follow the Heron by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Follow the Heron by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 35 North Ryan Street Details: Follow the Heron is an inviting coastal retreat located in the quiet Summer’s Edge neighborhood of Seagrove Beach. Offering approximately 2,020 square feet of interior living space, this thoughtfully designed home comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests with three bedrooms, three full baths, and an additional kid’s den with built-in sleeping accommodations. Two living areas and a spacious layout provide plenty of room for families to gather while still enjoying their own space. Outdoor living is a highlight of Follow the Heron, with an expansive second-floor screened porch, covered front porch, rear grill deck, and enclosed outdoor shower. Guests also enjoy access to two community pools and a private neighborhood beach access approximately a five-minute walk from the home. With no through traffic and convenient access to the Timpoochee Trail, Summer’s Edge offers a peaceful setting for enjoying the relaxed coastal lifestyle of Seagrove Beach. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 5-Minute Walk to Private Neighborhood Beach Access -Parking Spaces: (2) Large Vehicles or (3) Small Vehicles -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 6, Bar Seating for 3 -Coffee Maker Available -(2) Community Pools* -(2) Living Areas -Expansive Screened Porch -Covered Front Porch -Rear Grill Deck -Enclosed Outdoor Shower -Outdoor Gas Grill *One community pool is heated seasonally during winter and spring. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 8 3 Bedrooms + Kid’s Den / 3 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Detached Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area / Pantry / Laundry Room -Covered Front Porch -Rear Grill Deck -Enclosed Outdoor Shower Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Double Vanity) -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Kid’s Den: Twin/Twin Bunk* -Second Living Area -Screened Porch *The kid’s den is an open area and does not have a privacy door. Please Note: *LSVs and on-street parking are prohibited within the Summer’s Edge neighborhood. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
